title: Reading a memory segment
statement: Given a memory function $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, a starting address $a$, and a length $n$, the list read from that segment is the sequence $\mu(a),\mu(a+1),\ldots,\mu(a+n-1)$.
